frozen.comparison_rule: same cases, seeds, budget, horizon, observable information and feasibility constraints for every planner

recommended_action_contract_for_cross_te.mission_scope: exactly one survey site per decision round
recommended_action_contract_for_cross_te.effort_semantics: trap-equivalent units; 6 is anchored to the standard six-trap monitoring event while 1 and 3 are resource-allocation abstractions
recommended_action_contract_for_cross_te.reason: keeps the causal replan loop maximally legible, makes site+effort choice explicit, and avoids a combinatorial multi-site mission action during the 24h build

recommended_information_gain_contract.candidate_actions: all feasible (site, effort) pairs under the shared action contract
recommended_information_gain_contract.objective: expected reduction in sum of marginal occupancy entropy from the explicit spatial posterior
recommended_information_gain_contract.budget_aware_ranking_recommendation: compare expected information gain per effort unit, with absolute information gain as the first tie-break

recommended_rl_reward_for_cross_team_ack.effort_cost_term: omit in the primary reward because budget and horizon already constrain effort; report effort_used separately
recommended_rl_reward_for_cross_team_ack.normalization: use fractions/means rather than raw counts where possible to reduce graph-size dependence
recommended_rl_reward_for_cross_team_ack.guardrail: HiddenWorld may be used only for the terminal trainer/evaluator reward term and never policy inputs

formal_case_count_recommendation.note: small enough for hackathon runtime; increase only if runtime remains comfortably low

still_open_after_handoff: final number of training updates/episodes based on measured runtime and learning stability
claim_guardrail: Results demonstrate performance on the formalized synthetic decision task and robustness to the tested simulator/q assumptions, not proven field effectiveness.
